channel.title: Morning Gas & Energy Brief
channel.description: Phil's weekday morning brief: North American natural gas, Alberta weather and Lower-48 degree days, energy M&A, and geopolitics. Generated and narrated by Claude.
channel.itunes:author: Claude for Phil

item.title: Thu Oct 29 — November expires at $2.817, December takes prompt; EIA day
item.description: Deep gas: Nov expiry +12c, Dec prompt $3.03; EIA consensus +75 Bcf; feedgas back above 20; Freeport trip; NGTL linepack slips; Fed holds, BoC hikes.

item.title: Wed Oct 28 — BoC hike eyed, Fed decides, Ras Tanura struck
item.description: Central-bank double-header: BoC seen hiking to 2.50%, Fed expected to hold; Houthi strike claim on Saudi's biggest refinery keeps Brent above $115; November gas expires at $2.66.

item.title: Tue Oct 27 — Anthropic files for Nasdaq IPO; BoC hike eyed
item.description: Anthropic files to list as ANT; Fed meets, BoC seen hiking to 2.50% Wed; gas at two-year low into Nov expiry; Brent near $116; TTF highest since 2022.

item.title: Mon Oct 26 — EQT buys Range as gas hits two-year low
item.description: EQT-Range $50B+ all-stock deal; Henry Hub ~$2.52 lowest since Oct 2024 into Tuesday expiry; GDSR withdrawal and Alberta's first cold week; oil eases on Iran diplomacy; Fed and BoC Wednesday.

item.title: Fri Oct 23 — AI rout deepens, oil knocks on one hundred
item.description: Nasdaq's worst day since June on AI funding fears; Brent through $114; gas shrugs off a 10th tight build; Calgary's 26-degree weekend swing.

item.title: Thu Oct 22 — Gas at four-week low into storage print
item.description: Nov HH ~$2.75 after 4 down days; 10th straight tight build expected; NGTL linepack rebuilding; Calgary's first snow; Brent 5-month high on Saudi attacks.

item.title: Wed Oct 21 — Big Tech earnings day, Tesla-SpaceX merger talk
item.description: Meta and Tesla report tonight; SpaceX blowout and merger committees; oil re-bid near $100 on Iran; gas under $3; Smith's post-referendum address.

item.title: Tue Oct 20 — Alberta votes to stay, 77-23
item.description: Referendum decisively rejects separation; HH ~$3.01 two-week low; Canada CPI 3.1% with BoC 8 days out; oil off highs on Russia waiver vs Hormuz mine strike.

item.title: Mon Oct 19 — Gas at two-week low as mild stretch bites
item.description: Nov Henry Hub breaks its October uptrend to ~$3.08; tight storage vs mild-to-Oct-29; NGTL linepack still ~1 Bcf under; Alberta votes today.

item.title: Fri Oct 16 — Rotation day; storage surprise fades
item.description: AI selloff vs everything-else rally, TSX record; gas gives back the 67-Bcf pop; Hormuz grinds tighter; referendum Monday.

item.title: Thu Oct 15 — Gas bid at three-week high into storage print
item.description: Nov Henry Hub ~$3.25 ahead of EIA (cons ~+77 vs +90 5-yr); NGTL linepack still ~1 Bcf under target; hot US CPI puts an October hike at a coin flip; Houthi attacks escalate, two ships sunk in Hormuz.

item.title: Wed Oct 14 — CPI day: inflation re-accelerating, Dec hike priced
item.description: Sept CPI at 6:30 MT (cons 3.6%); gas flat at $3.17 with AECO back at $1.24; stocks slip on mixed banks and memory chips; TTF at 45-month high; ATCO Yellowhead $3B pipeline; referendum Monday.

item.title: Tue Oct 13 — Gas fades as Gulf supply returns
item.description: Deep gas: two-day HH fade on Isaias restarts and soft feedgas; NGTL's first furnace pull; Saudi strikes Houthis; banks kick off earnings.

item.title: Mon Oct 12 — Riyadh attacked, crude bid, loaded week
item.description: Houthi strikes on Saudi airports kill 12 incl. an American; Brent 06; gas eases to .17 as Isaias fizzles for gas; banks Tue, US CPI Wed; referendum one week out. Happy Thanksgiving.
